children.text: na yujyate caramabhavikasya bodhisattvasya mithyādṛṣṭikule upapattum
children.translated_text: It is not fitting for a final-birth Bodhisattva to be born in a family of wrong view.

children.text: tena sāpyapratirūpā ||
children.translated_text: Therefore it too is unsuitable."

children.text: apare 'pyāhuḥ ayaṃ hastināpure mahānagare rājā pāṇḍavakulavaṃśaprasūtaḥ śūro vīryavān varāṅgarūpasampannaḥ parasainyapramardakānāṃ tatkulaṃ pratirūpamasya bodhisattvasya garbhapratisaṃsthānāyeti
children.translated_text: Others also said, "This king in the great city <s>Hastināpura</s>, born in the family lineage of the <s>Pāṇḍavas</s>, is heroic, energetic, endowed with excellent beauty of form, a crusher of enemy armies; that family is suitable for this Bodhisattva's establishment in the womb."

children.text: apare 'pyāhuḥ tadapyapratirūpam
children.translated_text: Others also said, "That too is unsuitable.

children.text: kiṃ kāraṇam tathā hi pāṇḍavakulaprasūtaiḥ kulavaṃśo 'tivyākulīkṛto yudhiṣṭhiro dharmasya putra iti kathayati bhīmaseno vāyoḥ arjuna indrasya nakulasahadevāvaśvinoriti
children.translated_text: Why? For the family lineage has been made exceedingly confused by those born in the <s>Pāṇḍava</s> family: <s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s> is said to be the son of <s>Dharma</s>, <s>Bhīmasena</s> of <s>Vāyu</s>, <s>Arjuna</s> of <s>Indra</s>, and <s>Nakula</s> and <s>Sahadeva</s> of the <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: tena tadapi kulamapratirūpamasya bodhisattvasya garbhasaṃsthānāyeti ||
children.translated_text: Therefore that family too is unsuitable for this Bodhisattva's establishment in the womb."

children.text: apara āhuḥ iyaṃ mithilā nagarī atīva ramaṇīyā maithilasya rājñaḥ sumitrasya nivāsabhūmiḥ
children.translated_text: Others said, "This city <s>Mithilā</s> is exceedingly delightful, the dwelling-place of <s>Sumitra</s>, king of the <s>Maithilas</s>.

children.text: sa rājā prabhūtahastyaśvarathapadātibalakāyasamanvitaḥ prabhūtahiraṇyasuvarṇamaṇimuktāvaiḍūryaśaṅkhaśilāpravālajātarūparajatavittopakaraṇaḥ sarvasāmantarājābhītabalaparākramo mitravān dharmavatsalaḥ
children.translated_text: That king is accompanied by abundant forces of elephants, horses, chariots, and infantry; he has abundant wealth and equipment in gold, bullion, jewels, pearls, beryl, conch, stone, coral, wrought gold, and silver; his strength and valor are feared by all neighboring kings; he has friends and cherishes dharma.

children.text: tatkulaṃ pratirūpamasya bodhisattvasya garbhapratisaṃsthānāyeti
children.translated_text: That family is suitable for this Bodhisattva's establishment in the womb."

children.text: anya ūcus tadapyapratirūpam
children.translated_text: Others said, "That too is unsuitable.

children.text: astyasau rājā sumitra evaṃguṇayuktaḥ kiṃtvativṛddho na samarthaḥ prajāmutpādayitumatibahuputraśca
children.translated_text: That king <s>Sumitra</s> does indeed possess such qualities, but he is very old, unable to produce offspring, and already has very many sons.

children.text: tasmāttadapi kulamapratirūpamasya bodhisattvasya garbhapratisaṃsthānāyeti ||
children.translated_text: Therefore that family too is unsuitable for this Bodhisattva's establishment in the womb."

children.text: evaṃ bhikṣavaste bodhisattvā devaputrāśca sarvasmin jambudvīpe ṣoḍaśajānapadeṣu yāni kāniciduccoccāni rājakulāni tāni sarvāṇi vyavalokayantaḥ sarvāṇi sadoṣāṇyadrākṣuḥ
children.translated_text: In this way, monks, those bodhisattvas and divine sons, looking over all the high and lofty royal families in all <s>Jambudvīpa</s>, throughout the sixteen great regions, saw them all to be faulty.

children.text: teṣāṃ cintāmanaskāraprayuktānāṃ jñānaketudhvajo nāma devaputro 'vaivartiko bodhāya kṛtaniścayo 'sminmahāyāne
children.translated_text: As they were engaged in thought and reflection, a divine son named <s>Jñānaketudhvaja</s>, irreversible from awakening and firmly resolved in this <s>Mahāyāna</s>,

children.text: sa tāṃ mahatīṃ bodhisattvadevaparṣadametadavocat etanmārṣā etameva bodhisattvamupasaṃkramya pariprakṣyāmaḥ kīdṛgguṇasampanne kule caramabhaviko bodhisattvaḥ pratyājāyata iti
children.translated_text: addressed that great assembly of bodhisattvas and gods: "Noble ones, let us approach this very Bodhisattva and ask him, 'In a family endowed with what qualities is a final-birth Bodhisattva born?'"

children.text: sādhviti te sarve kṛtāñjalipuṭā bodhisattvamupasaṃkramya paryaprākṣuḥ kīdṛgguṇasampanne satpuruṣakularatne caramabhaviko bodhisattvaḥ pratyājāyata iti ||
children.translated_text: Saying, "Good," they all, with cupped hands joined in reverence, approached the Bodhisattva and asked, "In what jewel of a good person's family, endowed with what qualities, is a final-birth Bodhisattva born?"

children.text: tato bodhisattvastaṃ mahāntaṃ bodhisattvagaṇaṃ devagaṇaṃ ca vyavalokya etadavocat catuṣṣaṣṭyākārairmārṣāḥ sampannakulaṃ bhavati yatra caramabhaviko bodhisattvaḥ pratyājāyate
children.translated_text: Then the Bodhisattva looked over that great host of bodhisattvas and host of gods and said this: "Noble ones, a family is complete in sixty-four respects where a final-birth Bodhisattva is born.

children.text: katamaiścatuṣṣaṣṭyākāraiḥ tadyathā
children.translated_text: What are those sixty-four respects? They are as follows:

children.text: abhijñātaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family is renowned.

children.text: akṣudrānupaghāti ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family does not injure what is insignificant or lowly.

children.text: jātisampannaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family is endowed with noble birth.

children.text: gotrasampannaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family is endowed with lineage.

children.text: pūrvapuruṣayugasampannaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family is endowed with generations of ancestors.

children.text: abhijātapuruṣayugasampannaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family is endowed with generations of well-born men.

children.text: abhilakṣitapuruṣayugasampannaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family is endowed with generations of distinguished men.

children.text: maheśākhyapuruṣayugasampannaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family is endowed with generations of men of great fame.

children.text: bahustrīkaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family has many women.

children.text: bahupuruṣaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family has many men.

children.text: abhītaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family is fearless.

children.text: adīnālīnaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family is neither wretched nor sunken.

children.text: alubdhaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family is not greedy.

children.text: śīlavacca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family possesses moral discipline.

children.text: prajñāvacca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family possesses wisdom.

children.text: amātyāvekṣitaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati bhogān paribhunakti
children.translated_text: And that family is watched over by ministers and enjoys wealth.

children.text: avandhyaśilpaniveśanaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati bhogān paribhunakti
children.translated_text: And that family has establishments of crafts that are not fruitless, and it enjoys wealth.

children.text: dṛḍhamitraṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family has firm friends.

children.text: tiryagyonigataprāṇānuparodhakaraṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family does not cause harm to living beings born in animal wombs.

children.text: kṛtajñaṃ ca kṛtaveditaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family is grateful and mindful of what has been done for it.

children.text: acchandagāminaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family does not go according to desire.

children.text: adoṣagāminaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family does not go according to hatred.

children.text: amohagāminaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family does not go according to delusion.

children.text: abhayagāminaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family does not go according to fear.

children.text: anavadyabhīru ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family is afraid of what is blameworthy.

children.text: amohavihāri ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family lives without delusion.

children.text: sthūlabhikṣaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family gives substantial alms.

children.text: kriyādhimuktaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family is devoted to action.

children.text: tyāgādhimuktaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family is devoted to renunciation.

children.text: dānādhimuktaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family is devoted to giving.

children.text: paruṣakāramati ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family has a mind set on vigorous effort.

children.text: dṛḍhavikramaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family has firm valor.

children.text: balavikramaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family has strong valor.

children.text: śreṣṭhavikramaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family has excellent valor.

children.text: ṛṣipūjakaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family honors seers.

children.text: devatāpūjakaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family honors deities.

children.text: caityapūjakaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family honors caityas.

children.text: pūrvapretapūjakaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family honors the departed ancestors.

children.text: apratibaddhavairaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family bears no fixed enmity.

children.text: daśadigvighuṣṭaśabdaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family has a reputation proclaimed in the ten directions.

children.text: mahāparivāraṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family has a great retinue.

children.text: abhedyaparivāraṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family has an unbreakable retinue.

children.text: anuttaraparivāraṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family has an unsurpassed retinue.

children.text: kulajyeṣṭhaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family is the eldest among families.

children.text: kulaśreṣṭhaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family is the best among families.

children.text: kulavaśitāprāptaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family has obtained mastery among families.

children.text: maheśākhyaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family is of great fame.

children.text: mātṛjñaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family understands its mother.

children.text: pitṛjñaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family understands its father.

children.text: śrāmaṇyaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family is connected with śrāmaṇya, the life of renunciants.

children.text: brāhmaṇyaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family is connected with brāhmaṇya, the life of brahmins.

children.text: prabhūtadhanadhānyakoṣakoṣṭhāgāraṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family has abundant wealth, grain, treasuries, and storehouses.

children.text: prabhūtahiraṇyasuvarṇamaṇimuktājātarūparajatavittopakaraṇaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family has abundant money, gold, jewels, pearls, refined gold, silver, valuables, and goods.

children.text: prabhūtahastyaśvoṣṭragaveḍakaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family has abundant elephants, horses, camels, cattle, and sheep.

children.text: prabhūtadāsīdāsakarmakarapauruṣeyaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family has abundant female slaves, male slaves, laborers, and servants.

children.text: duṣpradharṣaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family is hard to assail.

children.text: sarvārthasiddhaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family accomplishes every aim.

children.text: cakravartikulaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family is a family of <s>cakravartins</s>.

children.text: pūrvakuśalamūlasahāyopacitaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family has been built up with the aid of former roots of merit.

children.text: bodhisattvakulakuloditaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And that family has arisen from a family of bodhisattvas.

children.text: anavadyaṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati sarvajātivādadoṣaiḥ sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake saśramaṇabrāhmaṇikāyāṃ prajāyām
children.translated_text: And that family is faultless, free from all faults spoken of in regard to birth, in the world with its gods, with its <s>Māra</s>, with its <s>Brahmā</s>, and among people with their śramaṇas and brahmins.

children.text: ebhirmārṣāścatuṣṣaṣṭyākāraiḥ samanvāgataṃ ca tatkulaṃ bhavati yasmiṃścaramaḥ bhaviko bodhisattva utpadyate ||
children.translated_text: With these sixty-four aspects, honored ones, that family is endowed, in which the Bodhisattva in his final existence is born.

children.text: dvātriṃśatā mārṣā guṇākāraiḥ samanvāgatā sā strī bhavati yasyāḥ striyāścaramabhaviko bodhisattvaḥ kukṣāvavakrāmati
children.translated_text: Endowed with thirty-two aspects of qualities, honored ones, is the woman into whose womb the Bodhisattva in his final existence descends.

children.text: katamairdvātriṃśatā yaduta abhijñātāyāṃ striyāṃ kukṣau caramabhaviko bodhisattvo 'vakrāmati
children.translated_text: With what thirty-two? Namely, the Bodhisattva in his final existence descends into the womb of a renowned woman.

children.text: abhilakṣitāyā acchidropacārāyā jātisampannāyāḥ kulasampannāyā rūpasampannāyā nāmasampannāyā ārohapariṇāhasampannāyā aprasūtāyāḥ śīlasampannāyāḥ tyāgasampannāyāḥ smitamukhāyāḥ pradakṣiṇagrāhiṇyā vyaktāyā vinītāyā viśāradāyā bahuśrutāyāḥ paṇḍitāyā aśaṭhāyā amāyāvinyā akrodhanāyā apagaterṣyāyā amatsarāyā acañcalāyā acapalāyā amukharāyāḥ kṣāntisaurabhyasampannāyā hryapatrāpyasampannāyā mandarāgadveṣamohāyā apagatamātṛgrāmadoṣāyāḥ pativratāyāḥ sarvākāraguṇasampannāyāḥ striyāḥ kukṣau caramabhaviko bodhisattvo 'vakrāmati
children.translated_text: The Bodhisattva in his final existence descends into the womb of a woman who is distinguished, whose conduct is without flaw, who is endowed with birth, endowed with family, endowed with beauty, endowed with name, endowed with height and breadth, who has not previously given birth, who is endowed with moral discipline, endowed with generosity, smiling-faced, receptive to what is auspicious, articulate, disciplined, confident, learned, wise, not deceitful, not crafty, not angry, free from jealousy, not stingy, not wavering, not fickle, not talkative, endowed with the fragrance of patience, endowed with shame and modesty, with slight passion, hatred, and delusion, free from the faults of womankind, devoted to her husband, and endowed with qualities in every respect.

children.text: ebhirmārṣā dvātriṃśatākāraiḥ samanvāgatā sā strī yasyāḥ striyāḥ kukṣau caramabhaviko bodhisattvo 'vakrāmati ||
children.translated_text: With these thirty-two aspects, honored ones, that woman is endowed, into whose womb the Bodhisattva in his final existence descends.

children.text: na khalu punarmārṣāḥ kṛṣṇapakṣe bodhisattvo mātuḥ kukṣāvavakrāmati api tu śuklapakṣe
children.translated_text: Moreover, honored ones, the Bodhisattva does not descend into his mother's womb in the dark fortnight, but rather in the bright fortnight.

children.text: evaṃ pañcadaśyāṃ pūrṇāyāṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ puṣyanakṣatrayoge poṣadhaparigṛhītāyā mātuḥ kukṣau caramabhaviko bodhisattvo 'vakrāmati ||
children.translated_text: Thus, on the fifteenth day, on the full-moon day when the moon is full, under the conjunction of the lunar mansion <s>Puṣya</s>, the Bodhisattva in his final existence descends into his mother, who has undertaken the poṣadha observance.

children.text: atha khalu te bodhisattvāste ca devaputrā bodhisattvasyāntikādimāmevaṃrūpāṃ kulapariśuddhiṃ mātṛpariśuddhiṃ ca śrutvā cintāmanaskārā abhūvan
children.translated_text: Then those bodhisattvas and those divine sons, having heard from the Bodhisattva himself this kind of purity of family and purity of mother, became intent upon reflection.

children.text: katamaṃ kulaṃ evaṃguṇasamanvāgataṃ bhaved yāvadvidham anena satpuruṣeṇa nirdiṣṭam teṣāṃ cintāmanaskāraprayuktānāmetadabhūt idaṃ khalvapi śākyakulaṃ ṛddhaṃ ca sphītaṃ ca kṣemaṃ ca subhikṣaṃ ca ramaṇīyaṃ cākīrṇabahujanamanuṣyaṃ ca
children.translated_text: What family could be endowed with such qualities, of the very kind described by this good man? As they were engaged in such reflection, this thought arose in them: This Śākya family indeed is wealthy, prosperous, secure, well supplied with food, delightful, and crowded with many people.

children.text: rājā śuddhodano mātṛśuddhaḥ pitṛśuddhaḥ patnīśuddho 'parikṛṣṭasampannāyāḥ svākārasuvijñāpakaḥ puṇyatejastejito mahāsaṃmatakule prasūtaścakravartivaṃśakulakulodito 'parimitadhananidhiratnasamanvāgataḥ karmadṛkca vigatapāpadṛṣṭikaśca
children.translated_text: King <s>Śuddhodana</s> is pure on his mother's side, pure on his father's side, and pure in his wife; he makes known his own noble form through unimpaired excellence, is radiant with the splendor of merit, born in the family of <s>Mahāsaṃmata</s>, arisen in the family-lineage of <s>cakravartin</s> kings, endowed with limitless wealth, treasuries, and jewels, mindful of karma, and free from sinful views.

children.text: sarvaśākyaviṣaye caikarājā pūjito mānitaḥ śreṣṭhigṛhapatyamātyapāriṣadyānāṃ prāsādiko darśanīyo nātivṛddho nātitaruṇo 'bhirūpaḥ sarvaguṇopetaḥ śilpajñaḥ kālajña ātmajño dharmajñastattvajño lokajño lakṣaṇajño dharmarājo dharmeṇānuśāstā avaropitakuśalamūlānāṃ ca sattvānāṃ kapilavastumahānilayaḥ
children.translated_text: In the whole Śākya realm he is sole king, honored and respected by guildmasters, householders, ministers, and councilors; he is gracious, handsome, neither too old nor too young, beautiful, endowed with every virtue, skilled in arts, knowing the proper time, knowing himself, knowing dharma, knowing reality, knowing the world, knowing marks, a king of dharma who rules by dharma; and <s>Kapilavastu</s> is the great abode of beings whose roots of merit have been planted.

children.text: ye 'pi tatropapannāste 'pi tatsvabhāvā eva
children.translated_text: Those who have been born there also have that same nature.

children.text: rājñaśca śuddhodanasya māyā nāma devī suprabuddhasya śākyādhipaterduhitā navataruṇī rūpayauvanasampannā aprasūtā apagataputraduhitṛkā surūpā salekhyavicitreva darśanīyā devakanyeva sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitā apagatamātṛgrāmadoṣā satyavādinyakarkaśā aparuṣā acapalānavadyā kokilasvarā apralāpinī madhurapriyavādinī vyapagatākhilakrodhamadamānadarpapratighā anīrṣukā kālavādinī tyāgasampannā śīlavatī patisaṃtuṣṭā pativratā parapuruṣacintāmanaskārāpagatā samasaṃhataśiraḥkarṇanāsā bhramaravarasadṛśakeśī sulalāṭī subhrūr vyapagatabhrukuṭikā smitamukhī pūrvābhilāpinī ślakṣṇamadhuravacanā pradakṣiṇagrāhiṇī ṛjvī akuṭilā aśaṭhā amāyāvinī hryapatrāpyasampannā acapalā acañcalā amukharā avikīrṇavacanā mandarāgadveṣamohā kṣāntisaurabhyasampannā karacaraṇanayanasvārakṣitabuddhiḥ mṛdutaruṇahastapādā kācilindikasukhasaṃsparśā navanalinendīvarapatrasuviśuddhanayanā raktatuṅganāsā supratiṣṭhitāṅgī sendrāyudhamiva yaṣṭiḥ suvinītā suvibhaktāṅgapratyaṅgā aninditāṅgī bimboṣṭhī cārudaśanā anupūrvagrīvā svalaṃkṛtā sumanā vārṣikī suviśuddhadarśanā suvinītāṃsā anupūrvasujātabāhuścāpodarī anupahatapārśvā gambhīranābhimaṇḍalā vṛttasuvistīrṇaślakṣṇakaṭhinakaṭirvajrasaṃhananakalpasadṛśamātrā gajabhujasamasamāhitasadṛśorū aiṇeyamṛgasadṛśajaṅghā lākṣārasasadṛśapāṇipādā jagati nayanābhiramyā apratihatacakṣurindriyā manāpapriyadarśanā strīratnarūpaprativiśiṣṭā māyānirmitamiva bimbaṃ māyānāmasaṃketā kalāvicakṣaṇā nandana ivāpsaraḥprakāśā śuddhodanasya mahārājasyāntaḥpuramadhyagatā
children.translated_text: And King <s>Śuddhodana</s>'s queen, named <s>Māyā</s>, daughter of <s>Suprabuddha</s>, lord of the Śākyas, was newly young, endowed with beauty and youth, childless and without sons or daughters, lovely, as if beautifully painted in varied outline, pleasing to behold, like a divine maiden adorned with every ornament, free from the faults of womankind, truthful, not harsh, not rough-spoken, not fickle, blameless, with the voice of a cuckoo, not talkative, sweet and pleasant in speech, rid of every trace of anger, intoxication, pride, arrogance, and hostility, not envious, speaking at the proper time, endowed with generosity, virtuous, content with her husband, devoted to her husband, free from thought or attention toward other men, with head, ears, and nose evenly formed, with hair like excellent black bees, fine-browed, beautiful-eyebrowed, without frowning, smiling-faced, speaking first in welcome, with smooth and sweet words, receptive to what is auspicious, straight, not crooked, not deceitful, not false, not crafty, endowed with modesty and moral shame, not flighty, not restless, not garrulous, not scattered in speech, slight in passion, hatred, and delusion, endowed with the fragrance of patience, with hands, feet, eyes, and mind well guarded, with soft young hands and feet, with a touch pleasant like fine cloth, with eyes pure as fresh lotus and blue-lotus petals, with a red and prominent nose, with firmly set limbs, a figure like a rainbow, well trained, with limbs and minor limbs well proportioned, with faultless limbs, bimba-fruit lips, beautiful teeth, a shapely neck, finely adorned, like jasmine blossoms, of pure appearance, with well-trained shoulders, well-formed arms in sequence, a bow-like waist, unmarred sides, a deep circle of the navel, rounded, broad, smooth, and firm hips, a frame resembling adamantine compactness, thighs resembling the well-set trunk of an elephant, shanks like those of an antelope, hands and feet like lac-dye, delightful to the eyes on earth, with an unobstructed faculty of sight, lovely and pleasant to see, distinguished by the beauty of a woman-jewel, an image as if magically created, conventionally named <s>Māyā</s>, skilled in the arts, shining like an apsaras in <s>Nandana</s>, dwelling within the inner palace of great King <s>Śuddhodana</s>.

children.text: sā pratirūpā bodhisattvasya jananī
children.translated_text: She is a fitting mother for the Bodhisattva.

children.text: yā ceyaṃ kulapariśuddhirbodhisattvenodāhṛtā sā śākyakula eva saṃdṛśyate ||
children.translated_text: And this purity of family that the Bodhisattva declared is seen precisely in the Śākya family.

children.text: tatredamucyate
children.translated_text: On this point the following is said:

children.text: prāsādi dharmoccayi śuddhasattvaḥ sudharmasiṃhāsani saṃniṣaṇṇaḥ
children.translated_text: The gracious, dharma-heaped, pure being sat upon the lion-throne of <s>Sudharmā</s>,

children.text: sabhāgadevaiḥ parivārito ṛṣiḥ saṃbodhisattvebhi mahāyaśobhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: the seer surrounded by gods of his assembly and by bodhisattvas of great glory.

children.text: tatropaviṣṭāna abhūṣi cintā katamatkulaṃ śuddhasusaṃprajānam
children.translated_text: Among those seated there a thought arose: What family is pure and of well-purified stock,

children.text: yadbodhisattve pratirūpajanme mātā pitā kutra ca śuddhabhāvāḥ ||
children.translated_text: where, for the fitting birth of the Bodhisattva, are mother and father pure in nature?

children.text: vyavalokayantaḥ khalu jambusāhvayaṃ yaḥ kṣatriyo rājakulo mahātmā
children.translated_text: Looking over the land called <s>Jambu</s>, they considered which kṣatriya royal family was noble;

children.text: sarvān sadoṣānanucintayantaḥ śākyaṃ kulaṃ cādṛśu vītadoṣam ||
children.translated_text: thinking of all the others as faulty, they saw the Śākya family as free from faults.

children.text: śuddhodano rājakule kulīno narendravaṃśe suviśuddhagātraḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Śuddhodana</s>, noble in a royal family, of very pure body in the lineage of kings,

children.text: ṛddhaṃ ca sphītaṃ ca nirākulaṃ ca sagauravaṃ sajjanadhārmikaṃ ca ||
children.translated_text: wealthy, prosperous, untroubled, venerable, good, and righteous.

children.text: anye 'pi sattvāḥ kapilāhvaye pure sarve suśuddhāśaya dharmayuktāḥ
children.translated_text: The other beings too in the city called <s>Kapila</s> are all of pure intention and joined to dharma;

children.text: udyānaārāmavihāramaṇḍitā kapilāhvaye śobhati janmabhūmiḥ ||
children.translated_text: adorned with parks, gardens, and monasteries, the birthplace in the place called <s>Kapila</s> shines.

children.text: sarve mahānagna balairupetā vistīrṇahastī navaratnavanti
children.translated_text: All are endowed with the strength of great elephants, with broad elephants, and possessed of the nine jewels;

children.text: iṣvastraśikṣāsu ca pāramiṃ gatā na cāparaṃ hiṃsiṣu jīvitārtham ||
children.translated_text: they have reached mastery in training with bows and weapons, yet they do not harm another for the sake of livelihood.

children.text: śuddhodanasya pramadā pradhānā nārīsahasreṣu hi sāgraprāptā
children.translated_text: The chief wife of <s>Śuddhodana</s>, foremost among thousands of women,

children.text: manoramā māyakṛteva bimbaṃ nāmena sā ucyati māyādevī ||
children.translated_text: is charming, a form as if made by magic; by name she is called <s>Māyādevī</s>.

children.text: surūparūyā yatha devakanyā suvibhaktagātrā śubhanirmalāṅgī
children.translated_text: Beautiful in form like a divine maiden, well proportioned in body, with auspicious and stainless limbs.

children.text: na so 'sti devo na ca mānuṣo vā yo māya dṛṣṭvātha labheta tṛptim ||
children.translated_text: There is no god, nor any human, who, after seeing <s>Māyā</s>, could ever find satiety.

children.text: na rāgaraktā na ca doṣaduṣṭā ślakṣṇā mṛdū sā ṛjusnigdhavākyā
children.translated_text: She is not colored by passion and not corrupted by hatred; her speech is smooth, gentle, straight, and affectionate.

children.text: akarkaśā cāparuṣā ca saumyā smitīmukhā sā bhrukuṭīprahīṇā ||
children.translated_text: She is not harsh and not rough, gracious, smiling-faced, and free from frowning.

children.text: hrīmā vyapatrāpiṇī dharmacāriṇī nirmāṇa astabdha acañcalā ca
children.translated_text: She is modest, ashamed of wrongdoing, a practitioner of <s>dharma</s> (righteous conduct), unaffected, not stiff, and not fickle.

children.text: anīrṣukā cāpyaśaṭhā amāyā tyāgānuraktā sahamaitracittā ||
children.translated_text: She is not envious, not deceitful, not guileful, devoted to giving, and has a mind joined with patience and loving-kindness.

children.text: karmekṣiṇī mithyaprayogahīnā satye sthitā kāyamanaḥsusaṃvṛtā
children.translated_text: She looks to karma, is free from wrong practice, stands in truth, and is well restrained in body and mind.

children.text: strīdoṣajālaṃ bhuvi yatprabhūtaṃ sarvaṃ tato 'syāḥ khalu naiva vidyate ||
children.translated_text: Whatever vast net of women's faults exists on earth, none of all that is found in her.

children.text: na vidyate kanya manuṣyaloke gandharvaloke 'tha ca devaloke
children.translated_text: There is no maiden in the human world, nor in the gandharva world, nor in the divine world

children.text: māyāya devīya samā kuto 'ntarī pratirūpa sā vai jananī maharṣeḥ ||
children.translated_text: equal to <s>Māyā Devī</s>; where could there be another? She indeed is the fitting mother of the great seer.

children.text: jātīśatāṃ pañcamanūnakāri sā bodhisattvasya babhūva mātā
children.translated_text: For five hundred births, without falling short, she was the mother of the <s>Bodhisattva</s>.

children.text: pitā ca śuddhodanu tatra tatra pratirūpa tasmājjananī guṇānvitā ||
children.translated_text: And <s>Śuddhodana</s> was his father in each case; therefore she is the fitting mother, endowed with virtues.

children.text: vratastha sā tiṣṭhati tāpasīva vratānucārī sahadharmacāriṇī
children.translated_text: She remains established in vows like a female ascetic, following vows and walking together in <s>dharma</s>.

children.text: rājñābhyanujñāta varapralabdhā dvātriṃśa māsāmava kāma sevahi ||
children.translated_text: Permitted by the king and having obtained her boon, for thirty-two months she abstained from sensual pleasure.

children.text: yatra pradeśe sthihate niṣīdate śayyāgatā ca kramaṇaṃ ca tasyāḥ
children.translated_text: Wherever she stands, sits, lies down, or walks,

children.text: obhāsito bhoti sadevabhāgo ābhāya tasyāḥ śubhakarmaniṣṭhayā ||
children.translated_text: that place, together with its divine sphere, becomes illuminated by her radiance, through her steadfastness in wholesome karma.

children.text: na so 'sti devāsura mānuṣo vā yo rāgacittena samartha prekṣitum
children.translated_text: There is no god, asura, or human able to look at her with a mind of passion.

children.text: paśyanti mātāṃ duhitāṃ ca sarve īryāpatheṣṭāryaguṇopapetā ||
children.translated_text: All see her as a mother or as a daughter, endowed in her deportment with noble virtues.

children.text: māyāya devyāḥ śubhakarmahetunā vivardhate rājakulaṃ viśālam
children.translated_text: Through the cause of <s>Māyā Devī</s>'s wholesome karma, the vast royal family increases.

children.text: pradeśarājñāmapi cāpracāro vivardhate kīrti yaśaśca pārthive ||
children.translated_text: Even among regional kings influence increases; the earthly king's fame and glory grow.

children.text: yathā ca māyā pratirūpabhājanaṃ yathāryasattvaḥ paramaṃ virājate
children.translated_text: Just as <s>Māyā</s> is a fitting vessel, and just as the noble being shines supremely,

children.text: paśyeta evāvadhikaṃ guṇānvitā dayā sutā sā jananī ca māyā ||
children.translated_text: so one should see compassionate <s>Māyā</s> as the limit of virtue, a daughter and mother endowed with qualities.

children.text: jambudhvaje 'nyā na hi sāsti nārī yasyā samarthā dharituṃ narottamaḥ
children.translated_text: In <s>Jambudvaja</s> there is no other woman capable of carrying the best of men,

children.text: anyatra devyātiguṇānvitāyā daśanāgasāhasrabalaṃ hi yasyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: apart from that queen endowed with surpassing virtues, for she has the strength of ten thousand elephants.

children.text: evaṃ hi te devasutā mahātmā saṃbodhisattvāśca viśālaprajñā
children.translated_text: Thus those great-souled divine sons and bodhisattvas of vast wisdom

children.text: varṇanti māyāṃ jananīṃ guṇānvitāṃ pratirūpa sā śākyakulanandanasya ||
children.translated_text: praised <s>Māyā</s>, the mother endowed with virtues; she is the fitting mother of the delight of the Śākya clan.

children.text: Chapter 4

iti hi bhikṣavo bodhisattvo janmakulaṃ vyavalokya uccadhvajaṃ nāma tuṣitālaye mahāvimānaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭiyojanānyāyāmavistāreṇa yasmin bodhisattvaḥ saṃniṣadya tuṣitebhyo devebhyo dharmaṃ deśayati sma taṃ mahāvimānaṃ bodhisattvo 'bhirohati sma
children.translated_text: Thus, monks, after examining the family of his birth, the <s>Bodhisattva</s> ascended, in the abode of <s>Tuṣita</s>, the great palace named <s>Uccadhvaja</s>, sixty-four yojanas in length and breadth, in which the <s>Bodhisattva</s>, seated among the Tuṣita gods, used to teach the Dharma.

children.text: abhiruhya ca sarvān tuṣitakāyikān devaputrānāmantrayate sma saṃnipatantu bhavantaḥ cyutyākāraprayogaṃ nāma dharmānusmṛticaryānuśāsanīṃ paścimaṃ bodhisattvasyāntikāddharmaśravaṇaṃ śroṣyatheti
children.translated_text: Having ascended it, he addressed all the divine sons belonging to the <s>Tuṣita</s> host: "Gather, sirs. You shall hear from the <s>Bodhisattva</s>'s presence the final hearing of the Dharma, the instruction in the practice of recollection of dharmas called the Application Concerning the Manner of Passing Away."

children.text: idaṃ khalvapi vacanaṃ śrutvā sarve tuṣitakāyikā devaputrāḥ sāpsarogaṇāstasmin vimāne saṃnipatanti sma ||
children.translated_text: On hearing these words, all the divine sons belonging to the <s>Tuṣita</s> host, together with their groups of apsarases, assembled in that palace.

children.text: tatra bodhisattvena caturmahādvīpake lokadhātuvistarapramāṇo maṇḍalamātrādhiṣṭhito 'bhūt tāvaccitrastāvaddarśanīyas tāvatsvalaṃkṛtas tāvatsuruciro yāvatsarve kāmāvacarā devā rūpāvacarāśca devaputrāḥ sveṣu bhavanavyūheṣu śmaśānasaṃjñāmutpādayāmāsuḥ ||
children.translated_text: There, by the <s>Bodhisattva</s>, a maṇḍala established with the extent and measure of a world-system of four great continents was made so variegated, so beautiful, so well adorned, and so lovely that all the gods of the desire realm and the divine sons of the form realm formed the perception of a charnel ground toward the arrangements of their own mansions.

children.text: tatra bodhisattvaḥ svapuṇyavipākaniṣyandaparimaṇḍite siṃhāsane niṣīdati sma anekamaṇiratnapādapratyupte anekapuṣpasaṃstarasaṃskṛte anekadivyagandhavāsopavāsite anekasāravaragandhanirdhūpite anekavarṇadivyapuṣpagandhasaṃstarasaṃskṛte anekamaṇiratnakṛtaśatasahasraprabhojjvālitatejasi anekamaṇiratnajālasaṃchanne anekakiṃkiṇījālasamīritābhinādite anekaratnaghaṇṭāśatasahasraraṇitanirghoṣe anekaratnajālaśatasahasraparisphuṭe anekaratnagaṇaśatasahasrasaṃchādite anekapaṭṭaśatasahasrābhipralambite anekapaṭṭadāmamālyaśatasahasrasamalaṃkṛte anekāpsaraḥśatasahasranṛtyagītavāditaparigīte anekaguṇaśatasahasravarṇite anekalokapālaśatasahasrānupālite anekaśakraśatasahasranamaskṛte anekabrahmaśatasahasrapraṇate anekabodhisattvakoṭīniyutaśatasahasraparigṛhīte daśadiganekabuddhakoṭīniyutaśatasahasrasamanvāhṛte aparimitakalpakoṭīniyutaśatasahasrapāramitāsaṃbhārapuṇyavipākaniṣyandasamudgate
children.translated_text: There the <s>Bodhisattva</s> sat on a lion-throne rounded by the outflow of the ripening of his own merit: studded with many jewel and gem legs, prepared with spreads of many flowers, perfumed with many divine fragrances and garments, fumigated with many excellent essential scents, arranged with spreads of divine flowers and fragrances of many colors, blazing with the radiance of hundreds of thousands of lights made from many gems and jewels, covered with nets of many gems and jewels, resounding with the tinkling set in motion by many networks of little bells, filled with the reverberating sound of hundreds of thousands of jeweled bells, shining with hundreds of thousands of jeweled nets, covered with hundreds of thousands of groups of jewels, hung with hundreds of thousands of cloth streamers, adorned with hundreds of thousands of cloth garlands and festoons, celebrated by the dancing, singing, and music of hundreds of thousands of apsarases, praised for hundreds of thousands of virtues, guarded by hundreds of thousands of world-protectors, saluted by hundreds of thousands of <s>Śakras</s>, bowed to by hundreds of thousands of <s>Brahmās</s>, surrounded by hundreds of thousands of koṭis and niyutas of bodhisattvas, attended by hundreds of thousands of koṭis and niyutas of Buddhas in the ten directions, and arisen from the outflow of the ripening of merit from the accumulation of pāramitās (perfections) over immeasurable hundreds of thousands of koṭis and niyutas of kalpas.

children.text: iti hi bhikṣava evaṃguṇasamanvāgate siṃhāsane niṣadya bodhisattvastāṃ mahatīṃ devaparṣadamāmantrayate sma vyavalokayata mārṣā bodhisattvasya kāyaṃ śatapuṇyalakṣaṇasamalaṃkṛtam
children.translated_text: Thus, monks, seated on a throne endowed with such qualities, the <s>Bodhisattva</s> addressed that great assembly of gods: "Look, venerable friends, at the <s>Bodhisattva</s>'s body, adorned with marks produced from a hundred merits."

children.text: vyavalokayata pūrvadakṣiṇapaścimottarāsv adha ūrdhvaṃ samantāddaśadikṣu aprameyāsaṃkhyeyāgaṇanāsamatikrāntān bodhisattvān ye tuṣitavarabhavanasthāḥ sarve caramabhavābhimukhā devagaṇaparivṛtāścyavanākāraṃ devatāsaṃharṣaṇaṃ dharmālokamukhaṃ saṃprakāśayanti
children.translated_text: Look to the east, south, west, north, below, above, and all around in the ten directions, at immeasurable, innumerable, incalculable bodhisattvas who dwell in the excellent palace of <s>Tuṣita</s>: all of them, turned toward their final existence and surrounded by hosts of gods, reveal the <s>dharmālokamukha</s> (gateway of Dharma-light) concerning the manner of descent, the gladdening of the deities.

children.text: adrākṣīt sā sarvā devaparṣad bodhisattvādhisthānena tān bodhisattvān
children.translated_text: Through the Bodhisattva's empowering presence, that whole divine assembly saw those bodhisattvas.

children.text: dṛṣṭvā ca punaryena bodhisattvastena sāñjaliṃ praṇamya pañcamaṇḍalairnamasyanti sma
children.translated_text: And after seeing them, facing toward the Bodhisattva, they bowed with joined palms and paid homage with the five points of the body.

children.text: evaṃ codānamudānayanti sma sādhu acintyamidaṃ bodhisattvādhisthānaṃ yatra hi nāma vayaṃ vyavalokitamātreṇeyanto bodhisattvān paśyāma iti ||
children.translated_text: And they uttered this inspired utterance: Wonderful! Inconceivable is this empowering presence of the bodhisattvas, since merely by looking we see so many bodhisattvas.

children.text: atha bodhisattvaḥ punarapi tāṃ mahatīṃ devaparṣadamāmantryaivamāha tena hi mārṣāḥ śṛṇuta cyutyākāraṃ devatāsaṃharṣaṇaṃ dharmālokamukhaṃ yadete bodhisattvā ebhyo devaputrebhyo bhāṣante
children.translated_text: Then the Bodhisattva again addressed that great divine assembly and said: Therefore, honored ones, listen to the <s>dharmālokamukha</s>, the gladdening of the deities concerning the manner of descent, which these bodhisattvas teach to these divine sons.

children.text: aṣṭottaramidaṃ mārṣā dharmālokamukhaṃ śataṃ yadavaśyaṃ bodhisattvena cyavanakālasamaye devaparṣadi saṃprakāśayitavyam
children.translated_text: Honored ones, this is a hundred and eightfold <s>dharmālokamukha</s>, which must necessarily be revealed by a bodhisattva in the divine assembly at the time of passing away from heaven.

children.text: katamattadaṣṭottaraśatam yaduta śraddhā mārṣā dharmālokamukham abhedyāśayatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: What is that hundred and eightfold teaching? Namely: faith, honored ones, is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to an unbreakable intention.

children.text: prasādo dharmālokamukham āvilacittaprasādanatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Serene confidence is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to the clarification of a turbid mind.

children.text: prāmodyaṃ dharmālokamukhaṃ prasiddhyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Gladness is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to success.

children.text: prītir dharmālokamukhaṃ cittaviśuddhyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Joy is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to purification of the mind.

children.text: kāyasaṃvaro dharmālokamukhaṃ trikāyapariśuddhyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Restraint of the body is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to purification of the three bodies.

children.text: vāksaṃvaro dharmālokamukhaṃ caturvāgdoṣaparivarjanatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Restraint of speech is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to avoidance of the four faults of speech.

children.text: manaḥsaṃvaro dharmālokamukham abhidhyāvyāpādamithyādṛṣṭiprahāṇāya saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Restraint of mind is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to abandoning covetousness, ill will, and wrong view.

children.text: buddhānusmṛtir dharmālokamukhaṃ buddhadarśanaviśuddhyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Recollection of the Buddhas is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to purity in seeing the Buddhas.

children.text: dharmānusmṛtir dharmālokamukhaṃ dharmadeśanāviśuddhyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Recollection of the Dharma is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to purity in teaching the Dharma.

children.text: saṃghānusmṛtir dharmālokamukhaṃ nyāyākramaṇatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Recollection of the Saṃgha is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to entering upon the right way.

children.text: tyāgānusmṛtir dharmālokamukhaṃ sarvopadhipratiniḥsargāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Recollection of generosity is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to relinquishing every acquisition.

children.text: śīlānusmṛtir dharmālokamukhaṃ praṇidhānaparipūrtyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Recollection of moral discipline is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to the fulfillment of vows.

children.text: devatānusmṛtir dharmālokamukham udāracittatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Recollection of deities is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to nobility of mind.

children.text: maitrī dharmālokamukhaṃ sarvopadhikapuṇyakriyāvastvabhibhāvanatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Loving-kindness is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to surpassing all conditioned bases of meritorious action.

children.text: karuṇā dharmālokamukhaṃ vihiṃsāparamatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Compassion is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to making harmlessness supreme.

children.text: muditā dharmālokamukhaṃ sarvāratyapakarṣaṇatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Sympathetic joy is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to the removal of all discontent.

children.text: upekṣā dharmālokamukhaṃ kāmajugupsanatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Equanimity is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to disgust toward sensual desire.

children.text: anityapratyavekṣā dharmālokamukhaṃ kāmarūpyārūpyarāgasamatikramāya saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Contemplation of impermanence is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to going beyond desire for the realms of desire, form, and formlessness.

children.text: duḥkhapratyavekṣā dharmālokamukhaṃ praṇidhānasamucchedāya saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Contemplation of suffering is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to cutting off longing.

children.text: anātmapratyavekṣā dharmālokamukham ātmānabhiniveśanatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Contemplation of selflessness is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to not clinging to self.

children.text: śāntapratyavekṣā dharmālokamukham anunayāsaṃdhukṣaṇatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Contemplation of peace is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to not kindling attachment.

children.text: hrī dharmālokamukham adhyātmopaśamāya saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Moral shame is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to inner calming.

children.text: apatrāpyaṃ dharmālokamukhaṃ bahirdhāpraśamāya saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Moral prudence is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to outward pacification.

children.text: satyaṃ dharmālokamukhaṃ devamanuṣyāvisaṃvādanatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Truth is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to not deceiving gods and humans.

children.text: bhūtaṃ dharmālokamukham ātmāvisaṃvādanatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Reality is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to not deceiving oneself.

children.text: dharmacaraṇaṃ dharmālokamukhaṃ dharmapratiśaraṇatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Practice of Dharma is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to relying on Dharma.

children.text: triśaraṇagamanaṃ dharmālokamukhaṃ tryapāyasamatikramāya saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Going to the three refuges is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to passing beyond the three bad destinies.

children.text: kṛtajñatā dharmālokamukhaṃ kṛtakuśalamūlāvipraṇāśāya saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Gratitude is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to not losing roots of wholesome action already performed.

children.text: kṛtaveditā dharmālokamukhaṃ parābhimanyatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Recognition of what has been done is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to esteem for others.

children.text: ātmajñatā dharmālokamukham ātmānutkarṣaṇatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Knowledge of oneself is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to not exalting oneself.

children.text: sattvajñatā dharmālokamukhaṃ parāpatsamānatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Knowledge of beings is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to regarding others' misfortunes as equal to one's own.

children.text: dharmajñatā dharmālokamukhaṃ dharmānudharmapratipattyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Knowledge of dharmas is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to practicing Dharma in accordance with Dharma.

children.text: kālajñatā dharmālokamukham amoghadarśanatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Knowledge of the proper time is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to vision that is not fruitless.

children.text: nihatamānatā dharmālokamukhaṃ jñānatāparipūrtyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Humility, with pride struck down, is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to the completion of knowledge.

children.text: apratihatacittatā dharmālokamukham ātmaparānurakṣaṇatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: An unobstructed mind is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to protecting oneself and others.

children.text: anupanāho dharmālokamukham akaukṛtyāya saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Absence of resentment is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to freedom from remorse.

children.text: adhimuktir dharmālokamukham avicikitsāparamatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Resolute conviction is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to being foremost in freedom from doubt.

children.text: aśubhapratyavekṣā dharmālokamukhaṃ kāmavitarkaprahāṇāya saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Contemplation of the impure is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to abandoning thoughts of sensual desire.

children.text: avyāpādo dharmālokamukhaṃ vyāpādavitarkaprahāṇāya saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Non-ill will is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to abandoning thoughts of ill will.

children.text: amoho dharmālokamukhaṃ sarvājñānavidhamanatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Non-delusion is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to dispelling all ignorance.

children.text: dharmārthikatā dharmālokamukham arthapratiśaraṇatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Seeking the meaning of Dharma is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to relying on the meaning.

children.text: dharmakāmatā dharmālokamukhaṃ lokapratilambhāya saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Love of Dharma is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to the attainment of the world.

children.text: śrutaparyeṣṭir dharmālokamukhaṃ yoniśodharmapratyavekṣaṇatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: The search for what has been heard is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to careful examination of dharmas.

children.text: samyakprayogo dharmālokamukhaṃ samyakpratipattyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Right application is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to right practice.

children.text: nāmarūpaparijñā dharmālokamukhaṃ sarvasaṅgasamatikramāya saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Complete knowledge of name-and-form is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to the passing beyond all attachment.

children.text: hetudṛṣṭisamudghāto dharmālokamukhaṃ vidyādhimuktipratilambhāya saṃvartate
children.translated_text: The uprooting of views about causes is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to the attainment of knowledge and resolute confidence.

children.text: anunayapratighaprahāṇaṃ dharmālokamukham anunnāmāvanāmanatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: The abandonment of attraction and aversion is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to the state of neither elation nor dejection.

children.text: skandhakauśalyaṃ dharmālokamukhaṃ duḥkhaparijñānatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Skill concerning the aggregates is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to complete knowledge of suffering.

children.text: dhātusamatā dharmālokamukhaṃ samudayaprahāṇāya saṃvartate
children.translated_text: The equality of the elements is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to the abandonment of arising.

children.text: āyatanāpakarṣaṇaṃ dharmālokamukhaṃ mārgabhāvanatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: The drawing away of the sense-bases is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to the cultivation of the path.

children.text: anutpādakṣāntir dharmālokamukhaṃ nirodhasākṣātkriyāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Forbearance toward non-arising is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to the direct realization of cessation.

children.text: kāyagatānusmṛtir dharmālokamukhaṃ kāyavivekatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Mindfulness directed to the body is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to bodily seclusion.

children.text: vedanāgatānusmṛtir dharmālokamukhaṃ sarvaveditapratipraśrabdhyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Mindfulness directed to feelings is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to the calming of everything felt.

children.text: cittagatānusmṛtir dharmālokamukhaṃ māyopamacittapratyavekṣaṇatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Mindfulness directed to mind is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to examination of mind as like an illusion.

children.text: dharmagatānusmṛtir dharmālokamukhaṃ vitimirajñānatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Mindfulness directed to dharmas is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to knowledge free from darkness.

children.text: catvāri samyakprahāṇāni dharmālokamukhaṃ sarvākuśaladharmaprahāṇāya sarvakuśaladharmaparipūrtyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: The four right efforts are a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to the abandonment of all unwholesome dharmas and the completion of all wholesome dharmas.

children.text: catvāra ṛddhipādā dharmālokamukhaṃ kāyacittalaghutvāya saṃvartate
children.translated_text: The four bases of spiritual power are a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to lightness of body and mind.

children.text: śraddhendriyaṃ dharmālokamukham aparapraṇeyatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: The faculty of faith is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to not needing to be led by another.

children.text: vīryendriyaṃ dharmālokamukhaṃ suvicintitajñānatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: The faculty of energy is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to well-considered knowledge.

children.text: smṛtīndriyaṃ dharmālokamukhaṃ sukṛtakarmatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: The faculty of mindfulness is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to action well performed.

children.text: samādhīndriyaṃ dharmālokamukhaṃ cittavimuktyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: The faculty of concentration is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to liberation of mind.

children.text: prajñendriyaṃ dharmālokamukhaṃ pratyavekṣaṇajñānatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: The faculty of wisdom is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to knowledge through examination.

children.text: śraddhābalaṃ dharmālokamukhaṃ mārabalasamatikramāya saṃvartate
children.translated_text: The power of faith is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to the passing beyond the power of <s>Māra</s>.

children.text: vīryabalaṃ dharmālokamukham avaivartikatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: The power of energy is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to non-retrogression.

children.text: smṛtibalaṃ dharmālokamukham asaṃhāryatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: The power of mindfulness is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to being unassailable.

children.text: samādhibalaṃ dharmālokamukhaṃ sarvavitarkaprahāṇāya saṃvartate
children.translated_text: The power of concentration is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to the abandonment of all discursive thoughts.

children.text: prajñābalaṃ dharmālokamukham anavamūḍhyatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: The power of wisdom is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to freedom from complete delusion.

children.text: smṛtisaṃbodhyaṅgaṃ dharmālokamukhaṃ yathāvaddharmaprajānatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: The awakening factor of mindfulness is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to knowing dharmas just as they are.

children.text: dharmapravicayasaṃbodhyaṅgaṃ dharmālokamukhaṃ sarvadharmaparipūrtyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: The awakening factor of investigation of dharmas is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to the completion of all dharmas.

children.text: vīryasaṃbodhyaṅgaṃ dharmālokamukhaṃ suvicitrabuddhitāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: The awakening factor of energy is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to richly discriminating intelligence.

children.text: prītisaṃbodhyaṅgaṃ dharmālokamukhaṃ samādhyāyikatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: The awakening factor of joy is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to fitness for concentration.

children.text: praśrabdhisaṃbodhyaṅgaṃ dharmālokamukhaṃ kṛtakaraṇīyatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: The awakening factor of tranquility is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to having done what had to be done.

children.text: samādhisaṃbodhyaṅgaṃ dharmālokamukhaṃ samatānubodhāya saṃvartate
children.translated_text: The awakening factor of concentration is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to awakening to equality.

children.text: upekṣāsaṃbodhyaṅgaṃ dharmālokamukhaṃ sarvopapattijugupsanatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: The awakening factor of equanimity is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to revulsion toward every rebirth.

children.text: samyagdṛṣṭir dharmālokamukhaṃ nyāyākramaṇatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Right view is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to entering the right course.

children.text: samyaksaṃkalpo dharmālokamukhaṃ sarvakalpavikalpaparikalpaprahāṇāya saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Right intention is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to the abandonment of all imaginings, discriminations, and constructions.

children.text: samyagvāg dharmālokamukhaṃ sarvākṣararutaghoṣavākyapathapratiśrutkāsamatānubodhanatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Right speech is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to awakening to the equality of all syllables, sounds, utterances, words, and echoes.

children.text: samyakkarmānto dharmālokamukham akarmāvipākatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Right action is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to the absence of karma and its fruition.

children.text: samyagājīvo dharmālokamukhaṃ sarveṣaṇapratipraśrabdhyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Right livelihood is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to the calming of all quests.

children.text: samyagvyāyāmo dharmālokamukhaṃ paratīragamanāya saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Right effort is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to going to the far shore.

children.text: samyaksmṛtir dharmālokamukham asmṛtyamanasikāratāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Right mindfulness is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to non-mindfulness and non-mental engagement.

children.text: samyaksamādhir dharmālokamukham akopyacetaḥsamādhipratilambhāya saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Right concentration is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to the attainment of unshakable concentration of mind.

children.text: bodhicittaṃ dharmālokamukhaṃ triratnavaṃśānupacchedāya saṃvartate
children.translated_text: The mind of awakening is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to the uninterrupted lineage of the Three Jewels.

children.text: āśayo dharmālokamukhaṃ hīnayānāspṛhaṇatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Disposition is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to having no longing for the <s>Hīnayāna</s>.

children.text: adhyāśayo dharmālokamukham udārabuddhadharmādyālambanatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Deep resolve is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to taking the lofty Buddha-dharmas and so forth as its object.

children.text: prayogo dharmālokamukhaṃ sarvakuśaladharmaparipūrtyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Application is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to the completion of all wholesome dharmas.

children.text: dānapāramitā dharmālokamukhaṃ lakṣaṇānuvyañjanabuddhakṣatrapariśuddhyai matsarisattvaparipācanatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: The perfection of giving is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to purification of the marks, minor signs, and Buddha-field, and to the maturation of stingy beings.

children.text: śīlapāramitā dharmālokamukhaṃ sarvākṣaṇāpāyasamatikramāya duḥśīlasattvaparipācanatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: The perfection of moral discipline is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to the passing beyond all unfortunate occasions and bad destinies, and to the maturation of beings of bad conduct.

children.text: kṣāntipāramitā dharmālokamukhaṃ sarvavyāpādakhiladoṣamānamadadarpaprahāṇāya vyāpannacittasattvaparipācanatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: The perfection of patience is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to the abandonment of all malice, hardness, fault, conceit, intoxication, and arrogance, and to the maturation of beings whose minds are hostile.

children.text: vīryapāramitā dharmālokamukhaṃ sarvakuśalamūladharmāraṅgottāraṇāya kuśīdasattvaparipācanatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: The perfection of energy is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to the bringing forth of all dharmas that are roots of the wholesome, and to the maturation of lazy beings.

children.text: dhyānapāramitā dharmālokamukhaṃ sarvajñānābhijñotpādāya vikṣiptacittasattvaparipācanatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: The perfection of meditation is a gateway to the light of Dharma, leading to the arising of all knowledge and direct knowledges, and to the maturation of beings with distracted minds.

children.text: prajñāpāramitā dharmālokamukham avidyāmohatamo'ndhakāropalambhadṛṣṭiprahāṇāya duṣprajñasattvaparipācanatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: The perfection of wisdom is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to abandoning ignorance, delusion, the darkness of gloom, grasping, and wrong view, and to the ripening of beings of poor wisdom.

children.text: upāyakauśalaṃ dharmālokamukhaṃ yathādhimuktasattveryāpathasaṃdarśanāya sarvabuddhadharmāvidhamanatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Skill in means is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to showing modes of conduct suited to beings according to their dispositions, and to the non-destruction of all Buddha-dharmas.

children.text: catvāri saṃgrahavastūni dharmālokamukhaṃ sattvasaṃgrahāya saṃbodhiprāptasya ca dharmasaṃpratyavekṣaṇatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: The four means of gathering are a gateway of Dharma-light; they conduce to gathering beings and, for one who has attained awakening, to the careful examination of the Dharma.

children.text: sattvaparipāko dharmālokamukham ātmasukhānadhyavasānāyāparikhedatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: The ripening of beings is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to not clinging to one's own happiness and to freedom from weariness.

children.text: saddharmaparigraho dharmālokamukhaṃ sarvasattvasaṃkleśaprahāṇāya saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Taking hold of the true Dharma is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to abandoning the defilement of all beings.

children.text: puṇyasaṃbhāro dharmālokamukhaṃ sarvasattvopajīvyatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: The accumulation of merit is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to being a support for the livelihood of all beings.

children.text: jñānasaṃbhāro dharmālokamukhaṃ daśabalapratipūrtyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: The accumulation of knowledge is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to the fulfilment of the ten powers.

children.text: śamathasaṃbhāro dharmālokamukhaṃ tathāgatasamādhipratilambhāya saṃvartate
children.translated_text: The accumulation of calm is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to obtaining the concentration of a <s>Tathāgata</s>.

children.text: vidarśanāsaṃbhāro dharmālokamukhaṃ prajñācakṣuḥpratilambhāya saṃvartate
children.translated_text: The accumulation of insight is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to obtaining the eye of wisdom.

children.text: pratisaṃvidavatāro dharmālokamukhaṃ dharmacakṣuḥpratilambhāya saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Entry into the analytical knowledges is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to obtaining the eye of Dharma.

children.text: pratiśaraṇāvatāro dharmālokamukhaṃ buddhacakṣuḥpariśuddhyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Entry into the refuges is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to the purification of the eye of a Buddha.

children.text: dhāraṇīpratilambho dharmālokamukhaṃ sarvabuddhabhāṣitādhāraṇatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Obtaining <s>dhāraṇī</s> (retentive formula) is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to retaining what has been spoken by all Buddhas.

children.text: pratibhānapratilambho dharmālokamukhaṃ sarvasattvasubhāṣitasaṃtoṣaṇāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Obtaining eloquence is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to satisfying all beings with well-spoken words.

children.text: ānulomikadharmakṣāntir dharmālokamukhaṃ sarvabuddhadharmānulomanatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Acceptance in conformity with the Dharma is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to conforming to all Buddha-dharmas.

children.text: anutpattikadharmakṣāntir dharmālokamukhaṃ vyākaraṇapratilambhāya saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Acceptance of the non-arising of dharmas is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to obtaining a prediction.

children.text: avaivartikabhūmir dharmālokamukhaṃ sarvabuddhadharmapratipūrtyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: The irreversible stage is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to the fulfilment of all Buddha-dharmas.

children.text: bhūmerbhūmisaṃkrāntijñānaṃ dharmālokamukhaṃ sarvajñajñānābhiṣekatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: Knowledge of passing from stage to stage is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to the consecration of omniscient knowledge.

children.text: abhiṣekabhūmir dharmālokamukham avakramaṇajanmābhiniṣkramaṇaduṣkaracaryābodhimaṇḍopasaṃkramaṇamāradhvaṃsanabodhivibodhanadharmacakrapravartanamahāparinirvāṇasaṃdarśanatāyai saṃvartate
children.translated_text: The consecration stage is a gateway of Dharma-light; it conduces to the display of descent, birth, renunciation, difficult practice, approach to the seat of awakening, defeat of <s>Māra</s>, awakening to bodhi, turning of the wheel of Dharma, and great parinirvāṇa.

children.text: idaṃ tanmārṣā aṣṭottaraṃ dharmālokamukhaśataṃ yadavaśyaṃ bodhisattvena cyavanakālasamaye devaparṣadi saṃprakāśayitavyam ||
children.translated_text: This, venerable sirs, is that set of one hundred and eight gateways of Dharma-light which must necessarily be proclaimed by a <s>Bodhisattva</s> in the assembly of gods at the time of passing away.

children.text: asmin khalu punarbhikṣavo dharmālokamukhaparivarte bodhisattvena nirdiśyamāne tasyāṃ devaparṣadi caturaśīter devaputrasahasrāṇām anuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhau cittānyutpadyante
children.translated_text: Now, monks, while this chapter on the gateways of Dharma-light was being taught by the <s>Bodhisattva</s>, in that assembly of gods the minds of eighty-four thousand divine sons arose toward unsurpassed perfect awakening.

children.text: dvātriṃśateśca devaputrasahasrāṇāṃ pūrvaparikarmakṛtānāmanutpattikeṣu dharmeṣu kṣāntipratilambho 'bhūt
children.translated_text: And thirty-two thousand divine sons, who had performed former preparation, obtained acceptance with regard to the non-arisen dharmas.

children.text: ṣaṭtriṃśateśca devaputranayutānāṃ virajo vigatamalaṃ dharmeṣu dharmacakṣurviśuddham
children.translated_text: And for thirty-six nayutas of divine sons the dust-free, stainless Dharma-eye toward dharmas was purified.

children.text: sarvāvacca tuṣitavarabhavanaṃ jānumātraṃ divyaiḥ puṣpaiḥ saṃchāditamabhūt ||
children.translated_text: And the whole excellent palace of <s>Tuṣita</s> was covered knee-deep with divine flowers.

children.text: iti hi bhikṣavo bodhisattvastasyā devaparṣado bhūyasyā mātrayā saṃharṣaṇārthaṃ tasyāṃ velāyāmimāṃ gāthāmabhāṣata
children.translated_text: Thus, monks, in order to gladden that assembly of gods still more abundantly, the <s>Bodhisattva</s> at that time spoke these verses:

children.text: tuṣitavarabhavananilayādyadā cyavati nāyakaḥ puruṣasiṃhaḥ
children.translated_text: When the leader, the lion among men, passes away from his dwelling in the excellent palace of <s>Tuṣita</s>,

children.text: āmantrayate devān pramādamakhilaṃ visarjayata ||
children.translated_text: he addresses the gods: Abandon all heedlessness completely.

children.text: yā kāci rativiyūhā divyā manasā vicintitā śrīmān
children.translated_text: Whatever arrays of delight there are, divine and splendid, imagined by the mind,

children.text: sarvaśubhakarmahetoḥ phalamidaṃ śṛṇurasya karmasya ||
children.translated_text: this is the fruit caused by every wholesome action; listen to this karma.

children.text: tasmādbhavata kṛtajñā apūrvaśubhasaṃcayaṃ kṣapitveha
children.translated_text: Therefore be grateful; after exhausting here an unprecedented accumulation of merit,

children.text: mā gacchata punarapāyān asādhvasukhavedanā yatra ||
children.translated_text: do not go again to the lower realms, where there is suffering and no genuine happiness.

children.text: dharmaśca yaḥ śruto 'yaṃ mamāntike gauravamupajanitvā
children.translated_text: And this Dharma which has been heard in my presence, after giving rise to reverence for it,

children.text: tatra pratipadyathā prāpsyatha niyataṃ sukhamanantam ||
children.translated_text: practice it; you will certainly obtain endless happiness.

children.text: sarvamanitya kāmā adhruvaṃ na ca śāśvatā api na kalpāḥ
children.translated_text: All sensual pleasures are impermanent, unstable, not everlasting, and not even enduring for kalpas;

children.text: māyāmarīcisadṛśā vidyutphenopamā capalāḥ ||
children.translated_text: they are like an illusion or a mirage, like lightning and foam, fickle by nature.

children.text: na ca kāmaguṇaratībhiḥ tṛptirlavaṇodakaṃ yathā pītvā
children.translated_text: There is no satisfaction through delights in sensual qualities, just as there is none after drinking salt water.

children.text: te tṛpta yeṣa prajñā āryā lokottarā virajā ||
children.translated_text: Those are satisfied whose wisdom is noble, supramundane, and free from dust.

children.text: na taraṅgatulyakalpāḥ saṃgīti ca apsarobhi saṃvāsaḥ
children.translated_text: The seeming kalpas are wave-like; concerts and dwelling together with apsarases

children.text: anyonyagamayuktā yathaiva sāmāyi kāmaṃ ca ||
children.translated_text: are joined to mutual coming and going, and sensual pleasure is only momentary.

children.text: na ca saṃskṛte sahāyā na mitra jñātījano ca parivārāḥ
children.translated_text: In what is conditioned there are no helpers: not companions, not friends, not relatives, not retinues.

children.text: anyatra karma sukṛtādanubandhati pṛṣṭhato yāti ||
children.translated_text: Only well-done karma follows along and goes behind one.

children.text: tasmātsahitasamagrā anyonyaṃ maitracitta hitacittāḥ
children.translated_text: Therefore, harmonious and united, with minds of loving-kindness and minds set on one another's welfare,

children.text: dharmacaraṇaṃ carethāḥ sucaritacaraṇā na tapyante ||
children.translated_text: practice the conduct of Dharma; those who practice good conduct do not grieve.

children.text: buddhamanusmarethā dharmaṃ saṃghaṃ tathāpramādaṃ ca
children.translated_text: Recollect the Buddha, the Dharma, the Saṅgha, and also heedfulness;

children.text: śrutaśīladānaniratā kṣāntyā saurabhyasampannāḥ ||
children.translated_text: delight in learning, morality, and giving, and be endowed with fragrance through patience.

children.text: duḥkhamanityamanātmā nirīkṣathā yoniśo imā dharmā
children.translated_text: Look correctly upon these dharmas as suffering, impermanent, and without self;

children.text: hetupratyayayuktā vartante 'svāmikā jaḍābuddhyā ||
children.translated_text: joined with causes and conditions, they proceed ownerless, inert, and without understanding.

children.text: yā kāci ṛddhi mahyaṃ paśyata pratibhāṃ ca jñānaguṇatāṃ ca
children.translated_text: Whatever supernatural power of mine you see, and whatever eloquence and quality of knowledge,

children.text: sarvaśubhakarmahetoḥ śīlena śrutena cāpramādena ||
children.translated_text: all of it is caused by wholesome action, by morality, by learning, and by heedfulness.

children.text: anuśiṣyadhvaṃ mahyaṃ śīlena śrutena cāpramādena
children.translated_text: Instruct yourselves for my sake through moral discipline, learning, and vigilance,

children.text: dānadamasaṃyamenā sattvārtha hitārtha mitrārthaḥ ||
children.translated_text: through giving, restraint, and self-control, for the welfare of beings, for benefit, and for friendship.

children.text: na ca vākyarutaraveṇā śakyāḥ saṃpādituṃ kuśaladharmān
children.translated_text: Wholesome dharmas cannot be accomplished merely by the roar of words and speech.

children.text: pratipattimārabhethā yathā ca vadathā tatha karothā ||
children.translated_text: Begin the practice, and as you speak, so you should act.

children.text: mā khalu parāvakāśaṃ svayaṃ yatadhvaṃ sadā prayatnena
children.translated_text: Do not look for an opportunity in others; strive yourselves, always with effort.

children.text: na ca kaści kṛtva dadate na cāpyakṛtvā bhavati siddhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: No one gives success after another has done the work, and without doing it there is no accomplishment.

children.text: samanusmarathā pūrve yadduḥkhaṃ saṃsāre ciramanubhūtam
children.translated_text: Remember fully the suffering formerly experienced for a long time in <s>saṃsāra</s> (cyclic existence).

children.text: na ca nirvṛtī virāgo samanugato mithya niyataiva ||
children.translated_text: If revulsion and dispassion toward release have not followed, there is certainly wrong fixedness.

children.text: tasmātkṣaṇaṃ labhitvā mitraṃ pratirūpa deśavāsaṃ ca
children.translated_text: Therefore, having obtained the right moment, a suitable friend, and residence in a fitting country,

children.text: śreṣṭhaṃ ca dharmaśravaṇaṃ śametha rāgādikān kleśān ||
children.translated_text: and the excellent hearing of the Dharma, pacify the defilements beginning with passion.

children.text: mānamadadarpavigatāḥ sadārjavāmandavāśca aśaṭhāśca
children.translated_text: Free from conceit, intoxication, and arrogance, always straight, not sluggish, and without deceit,

children.text: nirvāṇagatiparāyaṇa yujyata mārgābhisamayāya ||
children.translated_text: devoted to the course toward <s>nirvāṇa</s> (extinction), apply yourselves to realization of the path.

children.text: mohakaluṣāndhakāraṃ prajñāpradīpena vidhamathā sarvam
children.translated_text: Dispel all the dark blindness stained by delusion with the lamp of wisdom.

children.text: sānuśayadoṣajālaṃ vidārayata jñānavajreṇa ||
children.translated_text: Tear apart the net of faults together with latent tendencies by the thunderbolt of knowledge.

children.text: kimapi subahu vadeyaṃ dharmaṃ yuṣmākamarthasaṃyuktam
children.translated_text: Though I might speak to you very much Dharma joined with your welfare,

children.text: na ca tatravatiṣṭhethā na tatra dharmasya aparādhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: if you do not stand firm in it, the fault there is not the Dharma's.

children.text: bodhiryathā mi prāptā dharmaṃ ca pravarṣayedamṛtagāmim
children.translated_text: As awakening has been attained by me and I have rained down Dharma leading to immortality,

children.text: punarapi viśuddhacittā upetha varadharmaśravaṇāya ||
children.translated_text: so, with purified minds, come again to hear the excellent Dharma.

children.text: Chapter 5

iti hi bhikṣavo bodhisattvastāṃ mahatīṃ devaparṣadamanayā dharmyayā kathayā saṃdarśya samādāpya samuttejya saṃpraharṣya kṣamāpayitvā maṅgalyāṃ devaparṣadamāmantrayate sma gamiṣyāmyahaṃ mārṣā jambudvīpam
children.translated_text: Thus, monks, the <s>Bodhisattva</s>, after instructing, engaging, rousing, and gladdening that great assembly of gods with this Dharma discourse, and after asking their pardon, addressed the auspicious assembly of gods: "Sirs, I shall go to <s>Jambudvīpa</s>.

children.text: mayā pūrvabodhisattvacaryāṃ caratā sattvāścaturbhiḥ saṃgrahavastubhirnimantritā dānena priyavadyenārthakriyayā samānārthatayā ca
children.translated_text: When I was formerly practicing the conduct of a <s>Bodhisattva</s>, beings were invited by me through the four means of gathering: giving, kindly speech, beneficial action, and equality of purpose.

children.text: tadayuktametanmārṣā mama bhavedakṛtajñatā ca yadahamanuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhau nābhisaṃbuddheyam ||
children.translated_text: Therefore, sirs, it would be improper for me, and would be ingratitude, if I were not to awaken to unsurpassed complete and perfect awakening."

children.text: atha te tuṣitakāyikā devaputrā rudanto bodhisattvasya caraṇau parigṛhyaivamāhur idaṃ khalu satpuruṣa tuṣitabhavanaṃ tvayā vihīnaṃ na bhrājiṣyate
children.translated_text: Then those divine sons belonging to the <s>Tuṣita</s> host, weeping, grasped the <s>Bodhisattva</s>'s feet and said this: "Good man, this abode of <s>Tuṣita</s>, deprived of you, will not shine."

children.text: atha bodhisattvastāṃ mahatīṃ devaparṣadamevamāha ayaṃ maitreyo bodhisattvo yuṣmākaṃ dharmaṃ deśayiṣyati
children.translated_text: Then the <s>Bodhisattva</s> spoke thus to that great assembly of gods: "This <s>Bodhisattva</s> <s>Maitreya</s> will teach you the Dharma."

children.text: atha bodhisattvaḥ svakācchirasaḥ paṭṭamaulaṃ cāvatārya maitreyasya bodhisattvasya śirasi pratiṣṭhāpayāmāsa
children.translated_text: Then the <s>Bodhisattva</s> removed the diadem and headband from his own head and set it upon the head of the <s>Bodhisattva</s> <s>Maitreya</s>.

children.text: evaṃ cāvocan mamāntareṇa tvaṃ satpuruṣa anuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhimabhisaṃbhotsyase ||
children.translated_text: And he said this: "Good man, after me you will awaken to unsurpassed complete and perfect awakening."

children.text: atha bodhisattvo maitreyaṃ bodhisattvaṃ tuṣitabhavane 'bhiniṣadya punarapi tāṃ mahatīṃ devaparṣadamāmantrayate sma kīdṛśenāhaṃ mārṣā rūpeṇa mātuḥ kukṣāvavakrāmeyaṃ tatra kecidāhur mārṣā mānavakarūpeṇa
children.translated_text: Then, having consecrated the <s>Bodhisattva</s> <s>Maitreya</s> in the abode of <s>Tuṣita</s>, the <s>Bodhisattva</s> again addressed that great assembly of gods: "In what form, sirs, should I descend into my mother's womb?" There some said, "Sirs, in the form of a young man."

children.text: kecidāhuḥ śakrarūpeṇa
children.translated_text: Some said, "In the form of <s>Śakra</s>."

children.text: kecidāhur brahmarūpeṇa
children.translated_text: Some said, "In the form of <s>Brahmā</s>."

children.text: kecidāhur mahārājikarūpeṇa
children.translated_text: Some said, "In the form of a great king."

children.text: kecidāhur vaiśravaṇarūpeṇa
children.translated_text: Some said, "In the form of <s>Vaiśravaṇa</s>."

children.text: kecidāhur gandharvarūpeṇa
children.translated_text: Some said, "In the form of a <s>gandharva</s> (celestial musician)."

children.text: kecidāhuḥ kinnararūpeṇa
children.translated_text: Some said, "In the form of a <s>kinnara</s> (celestial being)."

children.text: kecidāhur mahoragarūpeṇa
children.translated_text: Some said, "In the form of a <s>mahoraga</s> (great serpent-being)."

children.text: kecidāhur maheśvararūpeṇa
children.translated_text: Some said, "In the form of <s>Maheśvara</s>."

children.text: kecidāhuś candrarūpeṇa
children.translated_text: Some said, "In the form of the moon."

children.text: kecidāhuḥ sūryarūpeṇa
children.translated_text: Some said, "In the form of the sun."

children.text: kecidāhur garuḍarūpeṇa
children.translated_text: Some said, "In the form of <s>Garuḍa</s>."

children.text: tatrogratejo nāma brahmakāyiko devaputraḥ pūrvarṣijanmacyuto 'vaivartiko 'nuttarāyāḥ samyaksaṃbodheḥ sa evamāha yathā brāhmaṇānāṃ mantravedaśāstrapāṭheṣvāgacchati tādṛśenaiva rūpeṇa bodhisattvo mātuḥ kukṣāvavakrāmitavyaḥ
children.translated_text: There a divine son of the <s>Brahmā</s> host named <s>Ugratejas</s>, fallen away from a previous birth as a seer and irreversible from unsurpassed complete and perfect awakening, said this: "As it is found in the recitations of the mantras, Vedas, and treatises of the brahmins, in just such a form should the <s>Bodhisattva</s> descend into his mother's womb.

children.text: tatpunaḥ kīdṛśaṃ gajavaramahāpramāṇaḥ ṣaḍdanto hemajālasaṃkāśaḥ suruciraḥ suraktaśīrṣaḥ sphuṭitagalitarūpavān
children.translated_text: And what is that like? He should be a supreme elephant of great size, six-tusked, resembling a net of gold, very beautiful, with a deeply red head, and possessing a manifest, radiant form.

children.text: etacchrutvā rūpaṃ brāhmaṇavedaśāstratattvajño vyākarṣitaśca
children.translated_text: Having heard of this form, one who knows the truth of the brahmins' Vedas and treatises is drawn forth,

children.text: ito vai bhāvī dvātriṃśallakṣaṇopetaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and from this it is known: 'He will be one endowed with the thirty-two marks.'"

children.text: iti hi bhikṣavo bodhisattvo janmakālamavalokya tuṣitavarabhavanastha evaṃ rājñaḥ śuddhodanasya gṛhavare aṣṭau pūrvanimittānyupadarśayati sma
children.translated_text: Thus, monks, having considered the time of birth, while dwelling in the excellent palace of <s>Tuṣita</s>, the <s>Bodhisattva</s> displayed eight preliminary omens in the excellent house of King <s>Śuddhodana</s>.

children.text: katamānyaṣṭau tadyathā vyapagatatṛṇakhāṇukaṇṭakaśarkarakaḍhalyanirmalaṃ suṣiktaṃ suśodhitam anākulavātatamorajovigatadaṃśakamakṣikāpataṅgasarīsṛpāpagatam avakīrṇakusumaṃ samaṃ pāṇitalajātaṃ tadgṛhaṃ saṃsthitamabhūt
children.translated_text: What were the eight? Namely: that house stood level as the palm of a hand, with grass, stumps, thorns, gravel, and potsherds gone; spotless, well sprinkled, well cleansed, undisturbed by wind, darkness, or dust; with gnats, flies, moths, and creeping things gone; and strewn with flowers.

children.text: idaṃ prathamaṃ pūrvanimittaṃ prādurabhūt ||
children.translated_text: This was the first preliminary omen that appeared.

children.text: ye ca himavatparvatarājanivāsinaḥ patraguptaśukasārikākokilahaṃsakroñcamayūracakravākakuṇālakalaviṅkajīvaṃjīvakādayo vicitrarucirapakṣā manojñapriyabhāṣiṇaḥ śakunigaṇāḥ te āgatya rājñaḥ śuddhodanasya gṛhavare vitardiniryūhatoraṇagavākṣaharmyakūṭāgāraprāsādataleṣu sthitvā pramuditāḥ prītisaumanasyajātāḥ svakasvakāni rutānyudāharanti sma
